title: CortexBridge: Cortical Alignment of EEG Montages for Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.01124v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models are often pretrained with a fixed channel vocabulary or a limited set of montages, making transfer difficult when electrode layouts change. We propose CortexBridge, a lightweight adapter that combines EEG features with electrode and atlas coordinates to map arbitrary montages into a shared cortical latent space. Evaluated with three frozen foundation models on five brain-computer interface (BCI) datasets from the Mother of All BCI Benchmarks (MOABB), CortexBridge improves performance in 13 of 15 evaluations. The gains in balanced accuracy average 0.80% for EEGPT, 0.70% for LaBraM, and 3.26% for CBraMod, with a maximum gain of 13.02% on 12-class steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) classification. Visualizations of the learned atlas representations reveal task-dependent spatial patterns, with SSVEP showing a more concentrated representation in the Yeo Visual network than auditory P300

translated_title: CortexBridge：面向基础模型的EEG导联皮层对齐
translated_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）基础模型通常使用固定的通道词汇表或有限的导联集进行预训练，当电极布局发生变化时，模型迁移变得困难。我们提出了CortexBridge，这是一种轻量级适配器，它将EEG特征与电极和图谱坐标相结合，将任意导联映射到共享的皮层潜在空间中。在来自“所有脑机接口基准之母”（MOABB）的五个脑机接口（BCI）数据集上，使用三个冻结的基础模型进行评估，CortexBridge在15项评估中的13项中提升了性能。平衡准确率的平均提升为：EEGPT提升0.80%，LaBraM提升0.70%，CBraMod提升3.26%，在12类稳态视觉诱发电位（SSVEP）分类上最大提升达13.02%。对学习到的图谱表征进行可视化，揭示了任务相关的空间模式，SSVEP在Yeo视觉网络中表现出比听觉P300更为集中的表征。
tldr: CortexBridge是一种轻量级适配器，通过将EEG特征与电极和图谱坐标结合，把任意导联映射到共享的皮层潜在空间，解决了EEG基础模型因电极布局固定而难以跨导联迁移的问题，在15项评估中有13项取得性能提升。
en_tdlr: CortexBridge is a lightweight adapter that combines EEG features with electrode and atlas coordinates to map arbitrary montages into a shared cortical latent space, enabling EEG foundation models to transfer across varying electrode layouts and improving performance in 13 of 15 evaluations.
